A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Room for
answers.

Everything you might want to know before taking a closer look.

What is AERUNE?+

AERUNE is a fictional workplace air intelligence platform. This template demonstrates how building teams might explore changing indoor conditions.

Who is it for?+

The concept is designed for workplace, facilities, and building operations teams who look after shared spaces.

Are the readings on this page live?+

No. Every reading in the interactive example is simulated to show how the interface could work.

What can the timeline show?+

The example brings together an indoor CO₂ reading, occupancy, airflow, and a suggested response for three moments in a day.

Does the page connect to real sensors?+

No. This is an independent visual template and does not connect to a sensor, building system, or external service.

What happens when I request a demo?+

The form creates a local preview in your browser. It does not send or store your information.
